name: Shan Shui
author: ZeD
description: An endless Chinese landscape scroll painted on your desktop, stroke by stroke, left to right, in your theme's colors. Built on LingDong-'s {Shan, Shui}*. The drawing happens outside the shell at low priority; on screen it is one small shader. Paused, off or under a fullscreen window it costs nothing. English or Portuguese.

barWidget.description: 山 in the bar: click opens the menu (pause, new landscape, speed, motion, colors, language); right click turns it on and off
